newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein holds, late session quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein holds, late session quiet.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading but sentiment remained weak due to uncertainties, traders said on Friday.
They said olein was around 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta but quotes were also heard at 1,420-25 rupiah for small quantities. There were no known crude palm oil tenders through the week.
"The market is a little quiet," one trader said. "Buyers are waiting for developments, and were not keen to take positions."
Traders said President Suharto's call for market operations in essential commodities, including cooking oil, had raised the possibility of state agency BULOG intervening in the market.
"His statement had made buyers cautious because it effectively means prices should not rise," one trader said. "Everyone knows BULOG's target is 1,400 rupiah/kg."
Traders said prices were expected to remain soft next week due to Suharto's comment and the arrival of fresh shipments of palm olein in Jakarta.
They said some players were also selling down the market, but others were holding to their offer prices.
"These players are like typhoons. They come and they go. We are used to their ways," one said.
